job.title: Engineering Manager - Cloud Wallet
job.description:
We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger.

At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.

The team

To sustain the company's growth, Ledger is looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the Cloud Wallet team. This team is responsible for the backend services that power blockchain account management, transaction processing, and on-chain data aggregation across all Ledger wallet surfaces, from Ledger Live to the Ledger Enterprise platform. We believe in the power of functional programming to build robust and scalable platforms. We take time to share, challenge, and grow together through bi-weekly knowledge-sharing sessions, meetups, conferences, and open source contributions.

What you’ll be doing

  • Lead and grow your team. Own hiring, onboarding, performance management, and the professional development of your engineers. Run regular 1:1s, support career growth, and build a high-performing, engaged team.

  • Drive technical delivery. Own the team's roadmap and PI planning commitments. Ensure on-time, high-quality delivery across the team's service portfolio and ongoing architectural initiatives while coordinating across dependencies with Coin Integration, Ledger Enterprise, Ledger Live, and Infrastructure teams.

  • Maintain operational excellence. Own SLIs/SLOs for team services. Lead incident response posture, on-call culture, and observability standards for production-critical systems.

  • Architect for scale and reliability. Partner with tech leads and staff engineers to drive sound technical decisions on a polyglot stack (TypeScript, Scala) handling high throughput, multi-chain complexity, and strict reliability requirements. Review ADRs and ensure architectural coherence.

  • Champion engineering practices. Drive strong standards on CI/CD, testing (including end-to-end on testnets), code review quality, technical debt management, and AI-assisted engineering workflows.

  • Contribute to org-level initiatives. Participate in cross-BU architectural working groups, PI planning, and engineering efficiency programs.

You will collaborate cross-functionally with:

  • The Blockchain platform team for data model alignment, indexing and event streaming

  • The Coin Integration team for coin module ownership and new blockchain integrations

  • The Ledger Enterprise team for enterprise wallet features and operational alignment

  • The Ledger Live / Wallet XP teams as consumers of the team's backend APIs

  • The Infrastructure and SRE teams for platform reliability and scalability

  • The Product team for roadmap prioritization and customer-driven requirements

  • The Security team for vulnerability analysis and compliance

What we’re looking for

  • Proven experience (3+ years) managing backend engineering teams in a product-driven, distributed environment

  • Strong technical background in backend systems. You can credibly challenge architectural decisions, review design documents, and unblock engineers on hard technical problems

  • Experience operating services at scale and familiarity with high-availability architectures, event-driven systems, and observability tooling (RabbitMQ, PostgreSQL, Flink, NATS, Datadog or equivalent)

  • Comfortable with polyglot stacks. The team works across TypeScript and Scala; you don't need to be an expert in both but need enough depth to lead effectively

  • Track record of navigating complex multi-team dependencies and influencing across organizational boundaries without direct authority

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

  • Bonus points: exposure to blockchain or crypto infrastructure (account indexing, transaction lifecycle, UTXO vs account-based models), and a genuine interest in the Web3 space

job.description:
Internship - Total Rewards (Compensation & Benefits)

About Ledger

We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger.

At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.

The Team

Working closely with the Head of Total Rewards (London-based) and the Compensation & Benefits Expert (Paris-based), this role offers a unique combination of business-as-usual (BAU) operational and process management along with high-impact strategic project and analytical work.

What You’ll Be Doing:

Pay Equity Analytics

  • Pay Equity Modeling: Own the quantitative data preparation, variance testing, and baseline modeling for internal pay equity audits and gender pay gap analysis.

  • EU Directive Alignment: Actively support the team’s preparations for the upcoming EU Pay Transparency Directive by leveraging statistical analysis to identify and report on compensation trends across employee cohorts.

Equity Platform Dashboards & Maintenance

  • Grant List Creation & Validation: Prepare, audit, and validate equity grant lists, ensuring absolute accuracy before final approvals. Partner directly with HR Ops and Legal teams to deliver clean, compliant data for new equity grants.

  • Equity Tracking: Explore the creation of analytical dashboards/trackers to monitor global equity distribution, vesting schedules, and dilution tracking (e.g., BSPCE, Stock Options).

C&B Operations

  • Annual Review Support: Help run the operational backbone of our annual compensation review cycles (merit, performance, bonus) by managing data templates, tracking timelines, and coordinating with HRBPs.

  • Survey Submissions & Benchmarking: Coordinate and execute global compensation and benefits survey submissions, ensuring clean data mapping, and perform basic market benchmarking to support pay positioning decisions.

  • Patent Premiums Administration: Operationalize and administer our global patent/invention premiums, partnering closely with the Intellectual Property (IP) and Payroll teams to ensure seamless execution.

  • Workday Data Maintenance: Own the quarterly data upload process in Workday, ensuring all miscellaneous payroll bonus data is accurately tracked and updated on time.

What We’re Looking For

  • Education: Pursuing a Master’s degree in a highly quantitative discipline (e.g., Corporate Finance, Statistics, Financial Engineering, Business Analytics, Data Science, or Econometrics).

  • Advanced Mathematical Analytics: High mathematical baseline with strong capabilities in statistical modeling, variance tracking, and processing complex datasets. Advanced, robust Excel is a baseline requirement.

  • AI Tooling & Agentic Workflows (Strong Plus): Hands-on experience or deep curiosity regarding AI agents and workflow automation. Ideally, you know how to leverage tools like Claude and Gemini beyond basic prompting.

  • Execution & Balance: Adaptable and resourceful in a fast-paced, multicultural environment, proactive rather than reactive.

  • Languages: Fluent in English; French is a plus.

job.title: Business Line Manager - Swap
job.description:
About Ledger

We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger.

At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.

The mission of the Business Line Manager, Swap is to own and grow the Swap business line end to end: its revenue, its economics, its partner ecosystem, and above all the net rate Ledger delivers to users on every trade. You are the single accountable owner of Swap performance, operating with a Business Manager mindset over a business you run primarily through external providers and cross-functional partners rather than a large direct team.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Business Line Ownership & Revenue Delivery: Full accountability for Swap revenue, take rate, and volume. Building and defending the forecast, understanding every driver of week-over-week movement, and acting on it.

  • Net Delivered Rate as North Star: Owning the competitiveness of the in-wallet quote experience - quote quality and execution slippage combined. Keeping the competitive quote auction healthy and holding partners to their execution commitments.

  • Partner Management & Business Development: Managing, growing, and negotiating with the swap partner bench across CEX-swap, DEX-aggregator, and on-ramp providers - on pricing, coverage, routing eligibility, execution quality, and co-marketing. Managing concentration risk, building substitutability, and onboarding new providers to close coverage and cross-chain gaps.

  • Operational Excellence & Observability: Running the business line with rigour - incident management, error-rate reduction, quote and performance monitoring, and coverage reporting. Protecting the perfect run of existing partners and features is job one.

  • Analytical Leadership: Being the definitive source of truth on Swap. Querying data directly, sizing opportunities and risks quantitatively, and translating analysis into decisions and partner conversations.

  • Cross-Functional Delivery: Driving execution across Product, Technology, Finance, Legal, Pricing, and Marketing to ship improvements and resolve issues outside your direct reporting lines.

  • Market Insight: Maintaining a sharp understanding of the swap and on/off-ramp competitive landscape, provider economics, and cross-chain and DEX-native dynamics to inform positioning and the partner roadmap.

What we’re looking for:

  • Ownership mindset: Demonstrated ability to own a business line, product, or revenue stream end to end, making holistic, data-driven decisions across strategy, commercial, and operations.

  • Exceptional quantitative skills: Strong track record of using data and metrics to drive decisions. Comfort querying data directly (SQL / Snowflake experience a strong plus).

  • Commercial & business development experience: Proven results negotiating and managing external partners on pricing, terms, and performance. Sales or BD experience is highly valued.

  • Operational excellence: Evidence of running something with rigour - managing operational risk, reducing errors, and optimising conversion or engagement.

  • Influence in a matrixed organisation: Proven ability to align resources and drive complex cross-functional initiatives without direct authority.

  • Consumer fintech / service-revenue background: Experience in a high-volume transactional or service-revenue business is highly desirable. Fintech or equivalent service experience is a must.

  • Digital assets: Crypto experience is a strong plus.

  • AI: Strong appetite for what AI can bring to analysis and operations is a must.

  • Total English fluency: Role is based in Paris; French is not a prerequisite.

At Ledger, we are dedicated to continually investing in our employees which is why we offer more than just salaries; we provide comprehensive compensation packages that include a wide range of benefits. Here are some of the benefits you can look forward to:

  • Flexible work options - Our hybrid policy allows employees to work from home up to 3 times per week

  • Health & Wellness support - Health and Life Insurance.

  • Financial growth opportunities - Employees can become shareholders in Ledger as well as other financial benefits depending on your country of work.

  • Commuter allowance - Ledger offers a commuter allowance to contribute to your preferred means of transportation.

  • Learning & Development - A comprehensive suite of training solutions providing a personalised learning experience for every employee.

For regionally specific benefits, your Talent Acquisition contact will be able to provide you with more information.

We’re committed to building an inclusive hiring process. If you need any adjustments or accommodations, just let us know, we’ll do our best to support you.
